subGoals.rule: Each layer uses only the layer directly below it: presentation reaches persistence only through business code, and no lower layer uses an upper one (Buschmann et al. 1996, closed layering).

plantedDebt.what: the takings report reads JobGateway (persistence) directly from the presentation layer; allowed only as in the seed: its import of persistence/JobGateway, in its constructor and in dailyTakings

precedent: trap-shaped: the only existing report reads the persistence gateway from the controller, and two of the three requests ask to build the new report the way the existing one is built.

gaming.what: rename: the business layer re-exports JobGateway and MechanicGateway as JobSource and StaffSource, and the reports controller imports them from there, so no import crosses from presentation to persistence
